description.en: The audio format. Only **wav**, **mp3**, and **amr** formats are supported.

description.zh:
实例ID。

必须传入实例ID，否则调用会失败。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看您的实例ID。
><notice>
如果公共实例没有ID，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。
></notice>
description.en:
The instance ID.
You must specify an instance ID. Otherwise, the invocation fails. You can view your instance ID on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.
><notice>
If your public instance does not have an ID, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).
></notice>
The current page number, starting from 1, with a maximum value of 10000.

description.zh: 指定每页返回的语料条数，取值范围：1~50，默认值为20。
description.en: The number of corpus entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 20.

description.zh: 项目ID，是项目的唯一标识，您可以通过[项目管理控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/things-service/projects)获取项目ID。
description.en: The project ID, which is the unique identifier of the project. You can obtain the project ID from the [Project Management Console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/things-service/projects).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot query-speech-list --project-code 4de2c36700008c585e599200 --page-size 20 --page-id 1 --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --audio-format wav --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
